newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila says no change in foreign exchange policy.
newsitem.headline: Manila says no change in foreign exchange policy.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank reiterated on Wednesday it had no plan to change its foreign exchange policy, a senior Central Bank official said.
She was responding to a Singapore newspaper report which quoted Trade and Industry Secretary Cesar Bautista as saying the issue of devluation would be taken up today at a Monetary Board meeting.
"There is no change in policy. There is no such item on the agenda regarding devaluation," the official at the Central Bank's Treasury department said.
